tracks.name: Straight run
tracks.summary: The current endless road, framed from the start of a run through one obstacle cycle.

tracks.name: Flat oval
tracks.summary: A horizontal oval. One lap closes, and the game would repeat it.

tracks.name: Hill loop
tracks.summary: A closed lap. One big hill heading out, a turn back, two smaller hills heading home, a turn, and the straight back to the start.

tracks.name: Banked bends
tracks.summary: A closed lap. A banked turn-around, then an S that banks left and rolls straight over into a right bank, a wider banked turn-around, and the long straight home.

tracks.name: Lane count
tracks.summary: A closed lap with four bends at 1, 3, 2, and 3 lanes. Every lane change happens on a straight: 3→2 and 2→1 north, 1→2→3 back to back east, 3→1, 1→3, and 3→2 south, 2→3 west. The first four and 3→1, 1→3 hold an edge in pairs that cancel; the last two stay centered. A crate sits on every hold and every bend.

tracks.name: Lane fork
tracks.summary: A closed lap with two forks and two turn-arounds. Heading out, three lanes split into two and one; the two becomes one and the one becomes two, and they merge into three. The two drops its left lane and the one adds a lane on its right, so both slide half a lane right and the swapped lanes meet a centered road. Heading home, a plain fork: three split into two and one and merge again with no lane change.

tracks.name: Lumenwild trail
tracks.summary: Story stage 1. The road bends on three lanes, narrows to two through a corner, gives the lanes back, then narrows again. Still narrow, it drops and turns, opens, and takes one last curve into the finish. The road ends.

tracks.name: Lumenwild rise
tracks.summary: Story stage 2. Opens bending the other way from the trail, then narrows, and the hill arrives while it is still narrow. It opens into a wide curve, then drops and turns into the finish. The road ends.

tracks.name: Lumenwild pinch
tracks.summary: Story stage 3. Opens with a dip, then a curve and two hills, then the road closes to two and then to one. The single lane bends, then drops and turns into the finish. The road ends.

tracks.name: Vesper sweep
tracks.summary: Story stage 1. A long banked sweep on a wide road, then a level run to the finish. The road ends.

tracks.name: Vesper S
tracks.summary: Story stage 2. An S that banks left, rolls through level into a right bank, then a long run. The road ends.

tracks.name: Vesper hook
tracks.summary: Story stage 3. An unbanked bend, a long run, and a tighter unbanked bend into the finish. The road ends.

tracks.name: Shatterglass split
tracks.summary: Story stage 1. One fork. Three lanes split into two and one and meet again, then the road runs to the finish. The road ends.

tracks.name: Shatterglass switch
tracks.summary: Story stage 2. A switchback, then a fork, then the run to the finish. The road ends.

tracks.name: Shatterglass join
tracks.summary: Story stage 3. A fork that swaps its lanes, a turn, and a second fork into the finish. The road ends.

tracks.name: Reach ridge
tracks.summary: Two rounded summits with alternating approaches and open crest views; the canyon turns back through the valley. The road ends.

tracks.name: Reach climb
tracks.summary: A banked turning ascent opens onto the crest; a broad counter-turn frames the run home. The road ends.

tracks.name: Reach drop
tracks.summary: A sweeping ridge approach changes the vista before the banked plunge and recovery. The road ends.

tracks.name: Sineworks gate
tracks.summary: Story stage 1. The road narrows to two lanes, holds, and opens again before the finish. The road ends.

tracks.name: Sineworks beat
tracks.summary: Story stage 2. Lane changes come close together, down to one lane and back to three. The road ends.

tracks.name: Sineworks crush
tracks.summary: Story stage 3. The road closes to one lane, holds there, and opens again before the finish. The road ends.

tracks.name: Meridian drift
tracks.summary: Story stage 1. A long S that drops into a level ice crack and climbs back out. The road ends.

tracks.name: Meridian fork
tracks.summary: Story stage 2. An S into a fork, then a drop into a level ice crack and a climb back out. The road ends.

tracks.name: Meridian verge
tracks.summary: Story stage 3. A drop into a level ice crack, a fork whose branches swap lanes while the road is still down, then the climb out. The road ends.

tracks.name: Cathedral ribbon
tracks.summary: Story stage 1. One gentle banked sweep, then a level run. The road ends.

tracks.name: Cathedral vault
tracks.summary: Story stage 2. A rise into a banked turn, then a descent back to level. The road ends.

tracks.name: Cathedral choir
tracks.summary: Story stage 3. A banked climb that returns to level, then a fork, then the finish. The road ends.

tracks.name: Gap
tracks.summary: The deck stops, then starts again. The gap repeats on the same heading.
